answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 25378 Country: India Title: My Questation is that is it alowed to read Quran in Office ( Work Place ) when we seating on chair without Cap ( topi ),( kya hum kam karne ki jega kursi per beth ker topi pehna bina quran sarif padh sakte hey ) Question: Assalamualikum ,my Questation is that is it alowed to read Quran in Office ( Work Place ) when we seating on chair without Cap ( topi ),( kya hum kam karne ki jega kursi per beth ker topi pehna bina quran sarif padh sakte hey )?Thanks Answer ID: 25378 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1439/1439/M=1431) Yes, you can recite the holy Quran and if you have a cap (topi), you should wear it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
